full_judgment: 8. Mr. Fazlul Karim, Senior Advocate with Mr. N.K. Saha, Senior Advocate, instructed by Mr. Md. Nawab Ali, Advocate-on-Record appearing for the appellants submits that the High Court Division most illegally passed the impugned judgment and decree dismissing the appeal without considering that the suit is barred by limitation. He then submits that the learned Judges of the High Court Division without any valid reason opined that the alleged registered deed of gift was not a valid deed of gift admitting that the defendant-appellants have been possessing the suit land as their own property for more than 12 years. He then submits that the S.A. Khatian and R.S. Khatian were recorded in the name of the appellant's father and Khepa Chand Bairagi by a registered deed of gift transferred the suit property on 13.01.1977 in favour of his widow and two sons. He finally submits that present appellants have been possessing the suit land on payment of rent to the Government Sheresta and as such the impugned judgment and decree passed by the High Court Division is liable to be set aside.
